MonoJit: Mono arm64 JIT exception-unwinder crash (EXC_BAD_ACCESS/SIGSEGV, fixed pointer-auth-tagged fault address 0x038c1a03881a036c) when an OperationCanceledException unwinds out of a canceled shared-reference-generic Task<TResult_REF> through TaskAwaiter<T>.GetResult, resumed on the main-thread NSAsyncSynchronizationContext continuation, under accumulated full-suite JIT load. Layout-sensitive, so it reproduces only under full-suite load. Mono-only (Simulator); macOS CoreCLR and device NativeAOT keep running it.

MonoJit: Mono arm64 JIT exception-unwinder crash (EXC_BAD_ACCESS/SIGSEGV, fixed pointer-auth-tagged fault address 0x038c1a03881a036c) when an OperationCanceledException unwinds out of a canceled shared-reference-generic Task<TResult_REF> through TaskAwaiter<T>.GetResult, resumed on the main-thread NSAsyncSynchronizationContext continuation, under accumulated full-suite JIT load.
